S360.text: 시스터 허즈번드는 끝내 돌아오지 못했습니다. 성경 속 고인 명단에 새로 적힌 그 이름.
S360.en: Sister Husband never made it back. Her name, newly written among the departed in the family Bible.

S361.text: 폐허가 된 집터에서 다시 카메라를 드는 순간,
S361.en: The moment she lifts her camera again in the ruins of the house,

S363.text: 훗날 큰 상을 안겨 줄 바로 그 한 장.
S363.en: The very shot that will one day win her a big prize.

S365.text: 일하던 월마트가 포토로 옮겨 가, 이사를 앞둔 모녀.
S365.en: The Walmart where she works is moving to Poteau, so mother and daughter are about to move.

S375.en: Ray, a lawyer carrying an envelope, comes to see her.

S378.text: 시스터 덕분에 술을 끊었다는 금주 모임 동료.
S378.en: A fellow from Sister's sobriety meetings, who quit drinking thanks to her.

S381.text: 무려 4만 1천 달러라는 말에, 렉시는 음료를 뿜어 버립니다.
S381.en: At the words 'a whopping $41,000,' Lexie spits out her drink.

S382.text: 그 돈으로 짓는 새 보금자리, 모지스와 포니도 팔을 걷어붙입니다.
S382.en: With that money she builds a new home, and Moses and Forney roll up their sleeves to help.

S384.text: 시스터의 연인이던 스프락 씨가 원한 건 낡은 식탁 하나뿐이죠.
S384.en: All Sister's sweetheart, Mr. Sprock, wanted was her old kitchen table.

S385.text: 한편 윌리 잭은 루스 몰래, 거물 조니 데소토에게 줄을 대는데요.
S385.en: Meanwhile, behind Ruth's back, Willy Jack is trying to get in with big shot Johnny DeSoto.

S391.text: 엘리베이터를 기다리던 그때, 곁을 스쳐 가는 낯익은 얼굴.
S391.en: As he waits for the elevator, a familiar face brushes right past him.

S392.text: 서로 못 알아본 채 닫히는 엘리베이터. 코닥 사진 공모전 수상자는,
S392.en: The elevator closes before they recognize each other. And the winner of the Kodak photo contest is...

S395.text: 수상 소감으로 꺼낸 건, 먼저 떠난 친구 이야기.
S395.en: In her acceptance speech, she talks about a friend who has passed away.

S397.text: 오갈 데 없던 모녀에게 집이 되어 준 분이었습니다.
S397.en: She was the one who became a home for a mother and daughter with nowhere to go.

S399.text: 윌리 잭은 낯선 여자와 뒤엉켜 방에 들어서는데, 침대 위엔 루스가,
S399.en: Willy Jack stumbles into a room tangled up with a strange woman, but there on the bed is Ruth,

S404.en: A man he did time with in prison.

S409.text: 뒤통수친 게 들통난 마당, 이대로 버림받는 걸까요?
S409.en: Now that his double-cross is out, is he about to be dropped?

S411.text: 한편 시쿼야로 돌아온 노블리를, 렉시가 마중 나옵니다.
S411.en: Meanwhile, back in Sequoyah, Lexie comes to pick up Novalee.

S417.text: 조건 하나는 완벽한 새 남자친구, 과연 믿어도 될까요?
S417.en: A new boyfriend who's perfect on paper, but can he really be trusted?

S421.text: 딸을 안고 곯아떨어진 포니, 그 모습을 살며시 담아 두는 카메라.
S421.en: Forney has dozed off holding her daughter, and her camera quietly captures the moment.

S426.text: 고맙다는 말만 남기고 돌아서는 뒷모습, 정말 할 말은 그게 다였을까요?
S426.en: He turns and leaves with nothing but a thank-you. Was that really all there was to say?

S427.text: 얼마 뒤, 사진을 고르던 중 울리는 전화벨.
S427.en: Some time later, while she is sorting photos, the phone rings.

S433.text: 렉시 큰아이의 심상치 않은 전화. 한달음에 달려간 집 안은 엉망인데요.
S433.en: An alarming call from Lexie's eldest. She rushes over and finds the house in shambles.

S436.text: 문을 열자 눈에 들어온 건, 멍투성이가 된 친구의 얼굴.
S436.en: When she opens the door, what she sees is her friend's face, covered in bruises.

S437.text: 그 집 살림살이까지 몽땅 차에 싣는데요.
S437.en: She loads everything from that home into her car.

S440.text: 졸지에 아이 부자가 된 식탁, 밥 한 끼 먹이기도 전쟁.
S440.en: Suddenly the table is crowded with kids, and getting even one meal into them is a battle.

S442.text: 아이들이 잠든 밤, 현관에 나와 있는 렉시 곁으로 갑니다.
S442.en: Once the kids are asleep, she goes out to Lexie on the porch.

S444.text: 악몽 같던 그날은, 로저가 오기로 한 날이었다는데요.
S444.en: That nightmare day was the day Roger was supposed to come over.

S448.text: 집 앞엔 이미 그 뷰익이 서 있었죠.
S448.en: That Buick was already parked in front of the house.

S452.text: 막힌 문 너머, 로저는 아이들에게 몹쓸 짓을 하고 있었습니다.
S452.en: Behind the blocked door, Roger was doing something terrible to the children.

S457.en: She blames herself for being fooled by how good he looked on paper.

S463.text: 삶은 한순간에도 바뀔 수 있으니, 나쁜 일은 놓아주라고.
S463.en: That life can change in an instant, so let the bad things go.

S466.en: That everyone has some meanness in them, but

S469.en: The tears she has been holding back come pouring out.

S471.text: 어느 날 숲길, 아메리쿠스의 엉뚱한 질문에도 막힘없는 척척박사.
S471.en: One day on a forest path, he has an answer for every one of Americus's odd questions.

S473.text: 짐을 풀다 다시 꺼내 본 그날의 사진, 입가에 절로 미소가 번집니다.
S473.en: Unpacking, she takes out that photo again, and a smile spreads across her face.

S474.text: 그러던 그때, 다급하게 달려온 구급차 한 대.
S474.en: Just then, an ambulance comes racing in.

S476.en: Forney's sister finally passes away, and

S477.text: 넋이 나간 그의 팔을 말없이 감싸는 손길.
S477.en: A hand quietly holding the arm of the dazed Forney.

S478.text: 모습을 감춘 포니가 머문다는 호텔, 그 방문 앞에 섭니다.
S478.en: At the hotel where Forney has been hiding away, she stands before his door.

S482.en: The two of them sit side by side on the bed.

S491.text: 울먹이는 포니를 감싸 안는 따뜻한 품.
S491.en: A warm embrace around the sobbing Forney.

S492.en: That day, the two of them make love for the first time.

S495.en: Folding laundry, she opens up about how she really felt.
